alerts.subject: [C10-MED] 10y Real Yield rising: 2.24% (+52bp off 90d-low)
alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-07-06
Current:  2.24%
90d low:  1.72%
Move:     +52bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year TIPS real yield jumped to 2.24% on 2026-07-06, up 0.52pp from its trailing 90-day low of 1.72%.

内容:
10年期TIPS实际收益率在2026-07-06升至2.24%，较过去90天低点1.72%上升了0.52个百分点。

Why it matters:
Rising real yields raise the discount rate on long-duration AI-capex cash flows and tighten financial conditions broadly — a fast spike like this pressures the same high-multiple, capex-heavy names the bubble-stress thesis is watching, and pairs with a stronger dollar as a tightening signal.

影响:
实际收益率快速上升会提高对AI资本开支这类长久期现金流的贴现率，同时收紧整体金融环境——这类急速飙升会给高估值、重资本开支的公司带来压力，也往往与美元走强一起构成收紧信号。

What this means:
The 10-year TIPS real yield rose to 2.26% on 2026-07-02, up 0.54 points from its trailing-90-day low of 1.72%.

内容:
10年期TIPS实际收益率在2026-07-02升至2.26%，较过去90天低点1.72%上升了0.54个百分点。

Why it matters:
Rising real yields tighten financial conditions and raise the discount rate applied to long-duration AI-capex bets; a move this size makes leveraged infrastructure buildouts materially more expensive to finance.

影响:

Hard drive prices change three times a day; structural growth in the storage industry may still have further to run.  Moomoo ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── What this means: A Moomoo news item reports severe hard-drive (storage) supply shortages, with prices reportedly changing three times a day, and flags 'structural growth' in the storage industry as still having further to run. 内容: Moomoo 的一篇新闻报道称硬盘（存储）供应严重短缺，价格据称一天变动三次，并指出存储行业的'结构性增长'可能仍有上行空间。 Why it matters: Storage/memory scarcity (HDD/NAND/DRAM/HBM) feeds directly into AI server bill-of-materials cost and lead times — a shortage this acute signals demand is outrunning supply chain capacity, which can either validate the AI-capex buildout (real demand) or amplify bubble-stress if hyperscalers are forced to overpay/stockpile ahead of need. 影响: 存储/内存（HDD/NAND/DRAM/HBM）的紧缺直接影响 AI 服务器的物料成本和交付周期——如此严重的短缺意味着需求正在超过供应链的承载能力，这既可能印证 AI capex 建设的真实需求，也可能加剧泡沫压力，因为超大规模厂商可能被迫提前囤货或高价采购。

That points to AI-driven demand spilling into commodity storage and squeezing margins/availability across the whole hyperscaler supply chain. 影响: NAND 历来是价格更低、走量更大的存储层级，如今与 DRAM 价格看齐，说明存储市场的紧张已经不局限于 HBM/DRAM，而是蔓延到大宗存储领域。这意味着 AI 需求正挤压整个超大规模厂商供应链的利润与供货能力。

A $1T valuation target also raises the bar for what 'success' must look like to justify current infrastructure spend. 影响: 一旦 IPO，OpenAI 将被迫披露真实财务数据——烧钱速度、营收、算力成本——终结目前只能靠超大规模厂商单方面披露来推测 AI capex 逻辑的信息不透明状态。1 万亿美元的估值目标也拉高了这笔基础设施投入必须证明自己划算的门槛。

alerts.subject: [C6-MED] Memory price surge begins to cool as consumers hit affordability limit — AI demand still keeps DRAM and NAND prices clim
alerts.body: Severity: MED Feed: https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=%22SSD%22+OR+%22HDD%22+OR+%22hard+drive%22+price+when:1d&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en Published: Sat, 04 Jul 2026 11:47:34 GMT Link: https://news.google.?oc=5 Memory price surge begins to cool as consumers hit affordability limit — AI demand still keeps DRAM and NAND prices climbing through Q3 2026 - Tom's Hardware Memory price surge begins to cool as consumers hit affordability limit — AI demand still keeps DRAM and NAND prices climbing through Q3 2026  Tom's Hardware ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── What this means: A Tom's Hardware headline reports consumer memory demand cooling on affordability limits, but AI-driven demand keeps DRAM and NAND prices rising through Q3 2026. 内容: Tom's Hardware 一篇报道称，消费级内存需求因可负担性见顶而降温，但 AI 驱动的需求仍在推动 DRAM 和 NAND 价格上涨，预计持续到 2026 年第三季度。 Why it matters: Persistent DRAM/NAND price strength despite softening consumer demand signals that AI-side buying (HBM, server memory) is now the marginal price-setter — a sign the memory supply chain is tightening around AI capex rather than broad consumer electronics. 影响: 尽管消费端需求走弱，DRAM 和 NAND 价格依然坚挺，说明 AI 侧的采购(HBM、服务器内存)已经成为价格的边际决定因素——这表明内存供应链的紧张正围绕 AI capex 展开，而非广义消费电子需求。
